en-US.name: Zynera Audio
en-US.summary: Stream high fidelity music, trending playlists, and audiobooks on Zynera.
en-US.description: Zynera Audio connects your Amazon Echo and Alexa devices directly to Zynera's audio catalogue. Enjoy uninterrupted music playback, curated playlists, and public domain classic audiobooks. Control playback hands-free using natural voice commands.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Zynera Audio to play relaxing music
Alexa, ask Zynera Audio to play my audiobook

en-IN.name: Zynera Audio
en-IN.summary: Stream Bollywood, Hindi, Punjabi, and International music on Zynera.
en-IN.description: Zynera Audio delivers premium music and audiobook streaming for Alexa users in India. Request songs by title, artist, mood, or genre with high-speed playback.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Zynera Audio to play Kesariya
Alexa, ask Zynera Audio to play Hindi songs

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Test with audio playback commands like 'Alexa, ask Zynera Audio to play Kesariya' or 'Alexa, ask Zynera Audio to play trending songs'. Ensure AudioPlayer is enabled.
